plainText:
(Japanese: GO FOR DREAM！ゴウ、夢への道！！ GO FOR DREAM! 's Road to Mew!!) is the 126th episode of Pokémon Journeys: The Series, and the 1,211th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on September 23, 2022.
 

==Plot==
At the hotel, Goh has forgotten his Rotom Phone on a table in the room where he and are staying. An incoming call from Quillon is ignored by a shadowy figure who figures out the passcode and opens the phone to watch images and videos of Goh's Inteleon, leading to a flashback of it as a , who became inspired to become an after seeing one in action, and eventually achieving this dream. Quillon calls again, but the figure using the phone hangs up on him and instead views a message sent by Danika about Project Mew, which reintroduces the research team's goal and its five Chasers: Quillon, Danika, Goh, , and Horace. Quillon makes yet another call, and the individual messing with the phone is revealed to be .

The narrator hosts one of his radio shows to read listener mail. The first letter comes from Chloe, which leads to a flashback of Goh's 's Evolution into ; while the second one is from Horace, which, in turn, leads to flashbacks of the Raid Battle against and the Trial Mission to and , both of which prominently featured . The clip show concludes with a storybook tale of Grookey's first errand.

This is the first time more than two have aired in the same series.
Like the two most recent clip show episodes, no main character is physically present.
The passcode of Goh's Rotom Phone, 5555, is a play on his name, as "five" can be read as "go" in Japanese.
, Goh, , and narrate the preview for the next episode.
This is the first time Ash, Goh, and Pikachu narrate a preview since JN114.
As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan.
